findings.title_en: Eye and face protection during grinding cannot be confirmed
Sparks travelling toward the storage area with no visible barrier
Grinder wheel guard cannot be confirmed

summary_en: There are three low-severity, uncertain findings and no confirmed high- or medium-severity findings. The first verification priority is the grinder wheel guard, followed by confirming eye and face protection and a clear spark path. The evidence does not require stopping work throughout the area, but grinding should pause until the specified on-site checks are completed.
